label.fetchFailed: Could not get the label from TikTok

error.TIKTOK_RATE_LIMITED: TikTok API rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.

error.TIKTOK_NO_ELIGIBLE_SHIPPING_SERVICE: No eligible shipping service was returned by TikTok.

error.TIKTOK_SHIPPING_DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE: TikTok shipping label is not available yet.
